harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (etcd was not pre-installed on any node), loaded application keys, simulated permanent loss of the node3 member by stopping etcd and deleting its data directory, removed the dead member via etcdctl while quorum (node1+node2) stayed up, added a fresh member for node3, and started a new etcd process there with --initial-cluster-state existing. The new member synced via raft and served all original keys. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot IDs and post-restart cluster/data health each time, finishing with all 3 members healthy and all keys intact.
actions_performed: Installed etcd v3.5.17 binaries (etcd, etcdctl) on node1, node2, node3 from upstream GitHub release since no package was available via dnf
Configured /etc/hosts and firewalld (etcd-client/etcd-server services) on all three nodes
Created systemd unit etcd.service on each node and bootstrapped a fresh 3-member cluster (initial-cluster-state=new)
Verified cluster health/member list, then wrote 5 application keys under /app/config, /app/users, /app/orders and confirmed replication to all 3 members
Simulated permanent loss of node3's member: stopped etcd on node3 and rm -rf'd /var/lib/etcd, confirming the directory no longer exists
From node1 (surviving 2-member quorum), ran etcdctl member remove on the dead node3 member ID and confirmed cluster stayed healthy with keys intact
Ran etcdctl member add for a new node3 member (peer URL http://10.100.176.12:2380), yielding a fresh member ID distinct from the original
Rewrote node3's etcd.service with --initial-cluster-state existing and a fresh /var/lib/etcd, started it, and confirmed it joined and synced raft state with the other two members
Verified 3-member cluster health, matching raft-applied-index across all members, and all 5 application keys retrievable directly from the new node3 member
Captured boot_id baseline on all three nodes, then restarted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time via systemctl reboot (async so acknowledgement returned pre-disconnect)
Polled each node until reachable again and diffed boot_id to prove an actual reboot occurred
After each node's restart, re-verified etcd service active, 3-member quorum, endpoint health, and full /app key set present before moving to the next node

evidence.requirement: Initial healthy 3-member etcd cluster established with application keys
evidence.summary: etcd installed and 3-member cluster bootstrapped (node1/node2/node3), member list and endpoint health show 3 started members, 5 application keys written and confirmed present via etcdctl get --prefix

evidence.requirement: node3 member permanently lost (baseline of failure), data unrecoverable
evidence.summary: Confirmed keys present on node3 pre-wipe, then stopped etcd and rm -rf'd /var/lib/etcd on node3; ls confirms directory no longer exists

evidence.requirement: Dead member removed while quorum preserved
evidence.summary: etcdctl member remove executed against node1/node2 endpoints for the dead node3 member ID; resulting member list shows only node1/node2, endpoint health reports both healthy

evidence.requirement: New working member added and joined on the same node3 system, replacing the lost one
evidence.summary: etcdctl member add created a new member (ID ed9ba029ee35a4fb, distinct from the original 4df5cadcd9d58187); new etcd process on node3 started with --initial-cluster-state existing and became active; member list/endpoint status/health show 3 started members with matching raft-applied-index 25, and keys are retrievable directly from the new node3 endpoint

evidence.requirement: Existing application keys intact after replacement
evidence.summary: etcdctl get /app --prefix against the new node3 endpoint returns all 5 original keys/values unchanged

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id df8bab0d...; reboot acknowledged pre-disconnect; post-reboot boot_id 332515f9... (changed); etcd active, 3-member quorum healthy, all app keys present via node1

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id f7db4b4e...; reboot acknowledged pre-disconnect; post-reboot boot_id a239eb9d... (changed); etcd active, 3-member quorum healthy, all app keys present via node2

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state (post member-replacement)
evidence.summary: Pre-replacement baseline boot_id 45c22b1f...; reboot of the replaced node3 acknowledged pre-disconnect; post-reboot boot_id 218f83b5... (changed); etcd active, member list shows all 3 members (including replaced node3 member ed9ba029ee35a4fb) with matching raft-applied-index 39, and all 5 application keys retrievable directly from node3
